##### Project general facts

Aquamarine I is a gated community of private villas by Breig Property, designed in a modern style that pairs natural materials with chic industrial finishes. The villas are offered in three- and four-bedroom layouts arranged over several levels, each with a generous living space, a private pool and a rooftop terrace, giving owners flexible room for family life, guests or work.

Outdoor living sits at the centre of every villa, with a swimming pool framed by sun loungers, a landscaped garden and a rooftop lounge with a jacuzzi and an outdoor kitchen. The community is protected by round-the-clock security, and a maintenance service takes care of routine upkeep so that the villas stay in pristine condition.

Interiors combine a fully equipped modern kitchen with built-in cabinetry and a dining area that looks out over the pool. Bedrooms are framed with natural wood panelling and come with work areas, floor-to-ceiling windows, spacious wardrobes and private en-suite bathrooms, and the villas are delivered fully furnished.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Batu Bolong is one of the liveliest corners of Canggu on the southwest coast of Bali, named after the sacred sea temple perched on a rock above the Indian Ocean. The area is known for its surf, its spiritual landmarks and the sunsets that draw locals and visitors to the shoreline every evening.

Echo Beach and other surf breaks are close by, and the streets around Batu Bolong are lined with cafes, restaurants, beach clubs and boutique shops. The wider Canggu area adds a varied choice of dining, shopping and entertainment, so everyday needs and leisure options are within easy reach.

Canggu is one of the most sought-after destinations for holiday stays in Bali, attracting surfers, families and long-stay visitors. Villas in Batu Bolong benefit from this steady flow of visitors, which supports both comfortable private use and rental income.
